Seven files call `enter_runtime` directly. I found them by searching the whole repository for the name. Every call is inside the `tokio` crate, and none of the other library crates use it.

| File | Line | How it is called |
|---|---|---|
| `tokio/src/runtime/handle.rs` | 326 | `context::enter_runtime(&self.inner, true, …)` |
| `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/current_thread/mod.rs` | 184 | `crate::runtime::context::enter_runtime(handle, false, …)` |
| `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread/mod.rs` | 86 | `crate::runtime::context::enter_runtime(handle, true, …)` |
| `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread/worker.rs` | 498 | `crate::runtime::context::enter_runtime(&handle, true, …)` |
| `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread_alt/mod.rs` | 74 | `crate::runtime::context::enter_runtime(handle, true, …)` |
| `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread_alt/worker.rs` | 500 | `crate::runtime::context::enter_runtime(&sched_handle, true, …)` |
